I'll tell you my method.
Take any small flying character and use my main script on BU to increase its speed, say, by 20 times.
Next, activate ESP for ProximityPrompt and look for the Part that appears. This way, you can find all the Parts for UTCM and Scientist in less than a day.

Important! Roblox has a limitation: ESP only works for objects that have loaded.
